# Little Smiles of Beverly Hills

> Pediatric dental practice in Beverly Hills specializing in holistic, minimally-invasive treatments for children including special needs care and sedation dentistry.

Little Smiles of Beverly Hills is led by Dr. Sepehr Nassiripour and offers comprehensive children's dental services with a focus on innovative, patient-centered care. The practice serves the Beverly Hills and Los Angeles area with expertise in special needs dentistry, emergency care, and advanced minimally-invasive treatments.

- Dr. Sepehr Nassiripour

- Special needs dentistry

- Silver Diamine Fluoride (SDF)

- IV sedation dentistry
- Emergency dentistry
- Holistic dental care
- Beverly Hills
- Children's dental care
- Loma Linda University School of Dentistry
- ICON treatment

- Space maintainers

## Specialized Treatments

- [Minimally Invasive Pediatric Dental Treatments](https://littlesmilesofbeverlyhills.com/minimally-invasive-treatments): Minimally invasive treatments including ICON, Curodont, and SDF
- [Children IV Sedation dentistry in Beverly Hills](https://littlesmilesofbeverlyhills.com/iv-pediatric-sedation-dentistry-beverly-hills): IV sedation dentistry services for anxious and special needs children
- [Root Canals for Kids](https://littlesmilesofbeverlyhills.com/kids-root-canals-in-beverly-hills): Pediatric root canals and pulpotomy procedures for children
- [Children partial denture](https://littlesmilesofbeverlyhills.com/pediatric-partial-dentures-in-beverly-hills): Pediatric partial dentures and space maintainers for children

## Specialized Patient Care

- [Special Needs Dentistry in Beverly Hills](https://littlesmilesofbeverlyhills.com/special-needs-dentist-in-beverly-hills): Specialized dental care for children with autism, Down syndrome, cerebral palsy
